title: Full reference reproduction · detailed audit

requirements.acceptance: One composed laboratory with 4 fume hoods, liquid-handling station, solid-dispensing station, glove box, washing/drying station, 5 fixed-base arms and 1 mobile KUKA; metric dimensions, collision geometry and source provenance; overview plus all station views.
requirements.gap: Four reconstructed workstations do not instantiate the whole published lab; A–F figure panels are not a specification of exactly six physical stations.

requirements.acceptance: Run FoundationPose on observed images with pinned object meshes/camera intrinsics; log estimated and known poses, initialization, resets and perception-caused failures. Synthetic observations must be labeled as simulation-only.
requirements.gap: Official FoundationPose has executed on the observed MATTERIX beaker fixture. Original glass passes 0/5 local pose gates despite an oracle initial mask; opaque control passes 5/5. These are correlated frames of one static instance. Posthoc ideal-depth substitution diagnoses local depth sensitivity, not a perception repair or robot-level reproduction.

requirements.acceptance: Frozen arbitrary-pose trial bank; physical lift, carry, placement/release, whole workflow and failures; include pose-estimation pipeline; report all attempts and interval for success rate.
requirements.gap: Prose/caption count conflict unresolved. Existing 2 heat confirmations are not 12 perception-driven trials.

requirements.reference: Fig.6B Liquid Pouring / publisher Source Data Fig6
requirements.acceptance: Frozen 10-attempt arbitrary-pose protocol; physical grip/tilt/untilt/return; independent receiver/spill/source counts and calibrated model-volume; report unsuccessful trials separately from volume samples.
requirements.gap: Three local positives are subsystem confirmations; negative whole workflow still fails. Published nine volume samples do not imply nine total attempts.

requirements.acceptance: Reproduce author insertion-conditioned semantic tip loading and synchronized tip motion, immersed aspiration, dispensing and disposal, plus rack/reservoir setup in the stated manipulator configuration. Verify liquid identity/volume and ordered transitions. Force-threshold or friction-fit loading is an additional local validation, not a published prerequisite.
requirements.gap: Physical plate placement now continues into the independently checked 105.5 s native pipetting workflow. Full station setup still lacks robot grasp/transport/placement of the tip rack and two-well reservoir; those are prepositioned. Their actual final poses must carry into the downstream OT2 sequence. Zero-shot real FR3/OT2 deployment remains a separate unexecuted claim.

requirements.acceptance: Couple native robot placement/contact to bidirectional heater/beaker/solution thermal states and chemical identity/concentrations for all 2000 s. Evaluate trace errors and event times independently; neither replay reference temperatures nor fit on evaluation outputs.
requirements.gap: The 2000 s native robot/contact/online-chemistry run has finished; scoped outcome is reported below. Original author chemistry parameters and the literal CSV Cl/CCCl versus narrative HI/EtI identity remain unresolved. Shadow controls are not independent physical trials.

requirements.acceptance: Same model and source parameters as high-temperature experiment, held-out 40 C heater target; native coupled trace and reduced conversion. No separate fitting of low-temperature outputs.
requirements.gap: A 40 C semantic shadow uses the same native contact history. This is not an independently executed 40 C physical trial, and the original author parameter set is still unavailable.

requirements.reference: Fig.5B; Supplement Fig.4; publisher Fig5 data
requirements.acceptance: Two actual robot-mediated additions with compound/mass ledger and color time series; formation then reduction of iodine/starch color; independently verify conservation, stoichiometry, mixing and timing.
requirements.gap: Source CSV 90 s versus text 250 s and concentration-unit typo remain unresolved; original kinetic parameters absent. A color animation alone is not chemistry reproduction.

requirements.acceptance: Physics-only versus physics+thermal semantics with same scene, random arm motion/40–100 C targets, 1000 steps, synchronized clocks and warm-up policy; report all 3 replicates per size, throughput and overhead with hardware/version.

requirements.acceptance: Trace arbitrarily nested task states, per-agent actions and transitions; physics-derived success and semantic guards must control transitions rather than annotations after a fixed replay.

requirements.acceptance: Warp DFSPH fluid solver coupled to MuJoCo robot/vessel contacts; verify incompressibility/divergence, stable fluid/container boundaries, transfer/spill/mass, timestep convergence and reciprocal coupling actually implemented.

requirements.acceptance: Dual Flexiv pick tube from rack, hand off and physically pour into beaker; perception, grasp generation and collision-aware planning must execute object-relative goals.

requirements.acceptance: Use the same object-centered task/EE-action skill on UR5e, adapting only embodiment/interface; physical grip, pour and varied object poses.
requirements.gap: Robot-specific scripted joint behaviors do not prove source cross-robot skill transfer.

requirements.acceptance: GELLO human teleoperation data -> documented dataset -> fine-tuned visuomotor policy -> held-out thin-stirrer pickup and sustained in-beaker stirring with contacts.
requirements.gap: Original GELLO dataset not available; synthetic expert demonstrations can unblock an explicitly adapted study but cannot satisfy original-human-data provenance.

requirements.acceptance: Single actual phone video -> hand pose + 3D object segmentation/tracking -> motion reconstruction -> varied physics-valid demonstrations -> BC -> held-out swirl rollouts. Preserve source-frame to generated-demo provenance.

requirements.acceptance: Replay or recreate documented wrong robot/frame calibration, use controller observations for correction, compare translation/orientation residuals on held-out configurations.
requirements.gap: These are reported hardware case-study values, not universal acceptance thresholds. Simulation injection is a separate validation.

requirements.acceptance: Instrument actual command timestamps and observed robot effects; reproduce an over-rate pacing fault, repair to target, retain negative control and before/after frequency/jitter records.
requirements.gap: The reference already addresses control timing; our novelty cannot claim timing was entirely ignored.

requirements.acceptance: Same camera capture across depth models; fit reconstructed tabletop plane, report held-out error, and demonstrate newly revealed collisions affect planning.
requirements.gap: Original image and depth-model identities not published; synthetic plane perturbation cannot reproduce the exact reported result.

requirements.gap: Privileged ground-truth receiver coordinates alone do not implement the deployment mechanism.

requirements.acceptance: Auditable agent calls construct or revise ingestion, sim, skill and deployment/evaluation; failed hypotheses retained; a correction/model/skill is actually reused on a subsequent task or embodiment with before/after evidence.
requirements.gap: Manually assembling tasks and showing videos does not reproduce autonomous engineering or retained experience.

requirements.gap: No source seed count or controlled timing protocol. Current work cannot claim these speedups.
